name: David McAllister - Après le § 78 - Am 36
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 78b. Calls on the Commission to immediately freeze the two regulations implementing the trade deal with the United States for as long as the US administration makes claims and threats in relation to Greenland; strongly encourages the Commission to put any further negotiations with the United States on hold;
